fields.FIR_Description: During the afternoon of 2025-06-15, around 12:35, the complainant received calls demanding Rs. 50,000 with warnings of consequences if the amount was not paid, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-06-15. A witness, Ramesh Pandian, reachable on 9000000469, was mentioned in the complaint. A further person, Nithin Velan, a person who arranged the contact, using the number 9000000004, is stated to be associated with the incident. No identifying details of the suspected person were available at the time of registration. Items referenced in the complaint: a witness statement and social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Caller allegedly demanded money with threats of consequences.
fields.Keywords: extortion, money demand, associate, witness statement, screenshot, witness, afternoon, residential colony
